editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out your future wife just traveled back in time to ask for your help. That is exactly what happens to the troublemaker Shin-chan when he meets Tamiko. She comes from a scary future called Neo Tokio, where a mean ruler has taken over everything. The vibe here is a wild mix of silly kid humor and a high-stakes rescue mission. You get to see Shin-chan being his usual goofy self, but with the added pressure of saving his adult self from a dystopian nightmare. It is a colorful, loud, and heartwarming ride that keeps you guessing about how a kid and a time-traveler can actually win.

What really works is the chemistry between the characters and the fast pacing that never lets you get bored. The action scenes are surprisingly fun, and the emotional twists hit just right. While some of the jokes might be a bit too random, the heart of the story is what stays with you. If you want a cozy movie night, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a great move if you love collecting anime.
endingExplained: After a big battle, Shin-chan and his friends manage to defeat the evil ruler of Neo Tokio. By working together, they break the control the villain had over the city and save the adult version of Shin-chan. Since the future is fixed, Tamiko has to go back to her own time. She says a sad but sweet goodbye to little Shin-chan, knowing they will eventually meet again in the future. Everything returns to normal in the present day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly comedies and time-travel adventures.
